description: The DS4.1 logits-head preparation tests of vLLM patch 0028, run from the candidate image's own vLLM tree: the packed target head loads, round-trips exactly, matches BF16 logits, keeps a token's logits bit-identical across batch sizes, is shared by the drafter's logits processor and replays in a CUDA graph; the existing shared and Markov head preparation still passes. ds41_fixtures.py supplies the two conftest fixtures without the conftest's test-only imports.
